I am old now, 78 years, and my hands are not as strong as before. This small plot near the house I keep for other crops mixed together, the way my mother taught me. I have no money for the shop fertilizers, and the rains here in Mtwara must be enough because I cannot carry water. My son's wife helps me sometimes, and when the weeding is too much I pay a young man from the village with a little money or some of the harvest.
